progress.scanning: Searching for a connectable Schneider/WSC mirror cabinet
progress.connecting: Connecting to the Schneider/WSC cabinet over Bluetooth/GATT
progress.verifying_button: Checking C6 for the cabinet's physical authorization marker (0x55)
progress.syncing: Physical authorization confirmed. Reading the cabinet state and synchronizing date/time.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Schneider Ambient BLE
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up **{name}**? Home Assistant will first establish the Bluetooth/GATT connection.

select_device.title: Select Schneider/WSC device
select_device.description: More than one compatible device was discovered. Select the cabinet you want to add.

press_button.title: Bluetooth connected — press the cabinet button now
press_button.description: Home Assistant is already connected to the Schneider/WSC cabinet and has confirmed the initial C6 state is not authorized. **Now press the physical pairing/learn button on the light or mirror cabinet.** After pressing the physical button, click **Continue**. Home Assistant will then verify that C6 changed to `0x55`.

no_devices.title: No Schneider/WSC device found
no_devices.description: No connectable Schneider/WSC cabinet was found. Check power, range and the ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy, then retry.

connect_failed.title: Could not prepare the Schneider/WSC connection
connect_failed.description: Home Assistant could not establish the GATT connection and confirm the initial C6 state. Retry.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

connection_lost.title: Bluetooth connection was lost
connection_lost.description: The connection was lost while the physical-button screen was open. Retry; Home Assistant must connect again before you press the cabinet button.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

button_not_confirmed.title: Physical button was not confirmed
button_not_confirmed.description: Home Assistant stayed connected but C6 did not change to `0x55` after you clicked Continue. Press the physical cabinet button again and retry.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

sync_failed.title: Post-authorization synchronization failed
sync_failed.description: C6 confirmed the physical button, but the post-authorization reads or date/time synchronization failed. Retry the full setup.\n\nTechnical detail: `{error}`

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported by this integration.

create_entry.success: **{name}** was successfully configured with Schneider Ambient BLE.
